title: RisuAI
summary: Roleplay-focused frontend with lorebooks, character/group chats, flexible prompts and input/output translation according to project docs.
documentation_observations: README documents lorebooks, group chats, user prompts, translation, plugins and optional Docker self-hosting.
Local storage and cloud transmission depend on actual deployment and selected providers.
limitations: Official documentation reviewed, but not installed or benchmarked by NaughtyBoddy. Low-refusal behavior, actual quality, privacy, performance and current release availability are not proven.
